15–30 min (plus the trips until the boat is diverted)

A ghost ship haunts the waters between Venore and Darashia. Travel by boat on that route until you are hijacked by the {wiki:Ghostship}, cross over to the southern boat, kill the undead in the hold and open the coffin to receive a {item:Plate Armor}. You leave through a magic portal that drops you at the Darashia port.
There is a ghost ship haunting the waters between Venore and Darashia.
Money for the boat trips (you may need to travel several times until the boat is diverted)
It may not happen the first time: repeat the Venore → Darashia trip until you are diverted to the Ghostship.
They say that at night (Tibia time) you are more likely to end up on the Ghostship (unconfirmed).

Go to the **Venore** boat and travel to **Darashia** with the captain ({npc:Captain Fearless}). Repeat until the boat is hijacked by the {wiki:Ghostship}. The NPC warns you about the ghost ship threat.
The NPC warns you about the Ghostship threat
Go down and fight your way along the gangplank to the **south** ship.
There are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}; the rare {creature:Captain Jones} may also show up.
On the south ship, go down the **west** stairs (the reward one). Down there are 2 {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, 1 {creature:Demon Skeleton} and 1 {creature:Ghost}. Kill them.
Go down the west stairs for the reward; go up the east stairs to leave
When you go down you land on a {item:Fire Field|fire} field. Step away straight away.
Use the coffin on the **east** side to get your {item:Plate Armor}.
Search the coffin for your reward
Go up again and then go up the **east** stairs (the exit one). Up there is a lone {creature:Ghost} and a {item:Magic Forcefield}. Step into this portal: you appear on the **Darashia** boat.
Also known as the Ghostship Quest.
